summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Stay Coral Collection. Backend: 26 pytest cases (properties list/filter/slug/404, inquiries validation + persistence, admin auth incl. bcrypt hash format & case-insensitive email, admin route protection, full property CRUD lifecycle) — all 26 passed. Frontend: homepage (hero/nav/whatsapp float/footer), collection tabs (3 historic / 2 manga), EN|ES switcher (nav + hero copy + localStorage scc_lang), /stays tabs (all/historic/manga counts correct), card -> /stays/:slug detail (3 gallery images, booking widget, Airbnb link, no broken images), 'Request to Book' -> /contact with property prefilled, contact submit -> success toast 'Thank you — we'll be in touch shortly' + inquiry visible in admin, admin login (wrong pw shows error, correct pw lands on dashboard with 5 properties + Inquiries tab), admin UI property create/edit/delete verified against public API, logout clears scc_token. /cartagena, /about, /journal render. Mobile (390px) menu + cards OK. One real UI defect found: navbar link/logo overlap in Spanish at <=1280px width.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / brute-force lockout — unlimited wrong-password attempts return 401 with no lockout (playbook asked for lockout after 5 fails). Also no httpOnly cookie session; token returned in JSON and stored in localStorage (XSS exposure).
Seed else-branch is a no-op: update_one({'slug':...}, {'$setOnInsert': {}}) does nothing, so existing property docs are never backfilled when SEED_PROPERTIES change. Dead/misleading code.
CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid/ineffective combination per CORS spec; use explicit origins.
Body accepts client-supplied id and slug, so a PUT can silently rewrite the id or rename the slug of an existing doc; no immutability guard.

ui_bugs.issue: Spanish nav labels overlap the absolutely-centered 'STAY CORAL' logo at viewport widths ~1024-1400px (measured @1280: last link right edge 651px vs logo left 551px — 'CONTACTO' renders on top of the logo). Reproduced with screenshot.
Edit/Delete icon buttons and property rows had no data-testid (blocked automated CRUD testing). FIXED by test agent: added admin-property-row-{slug}, admin-edit-{slug}, admin-delete-{slug}.

design_issues.screen: Contact page & Property detail booking widget
issues: Uses raw native <input type="date"> (browser default picker with mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover — inconsistent with the premium visual language
Contact page bottom-left area has a large empty whitespace block on desktop (form column much taller than info column)
Sonner toast renders top-center and overlays the fixed navbar logo/links
Very thin content (735-963 chars of text) compared to the homepage; journal shows only 'coming soon' placeholders — acceptable for Phase 1 but visibly sparse

action_items: Fix navbar overlap: make the logo part of the flex row (or reduce lg gap / raise the lg breakpoint) so Spanish labels never collide with the centered logo between ~1024-1400px.
Add brute-force protection (attempt counter + lockout) on /api/auth/login if the security playbook requirement applies; consider httpOnly cookie session instead of localStorage token.
Remove/implement the no-op seed update branch ($setOnInsert: {}) so seed changes actually backfill existing docs.
Restrict CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins since allow_credentials=True is set.
Optional polish: replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar; offset toast below the navbar; fill contact page whitespace.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup(): `await db.properties.update_one({'slug': p['slug']}, {'$setOnInsert': {}})` is a no-op — the comment claims backfill but nothing is written.
PUT /api/admin/properties/{slug} $sets the whole client payload including `id` and `slug`; exclude immutable fields server-side.
/api/auth/login has no throttling; JWT valid 7 days with no refresh/revoke path.
allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is contradictory CORS config.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Dashboard.jsx (added data-testid to property rows + edit/delete buttons)

rca_of_the_issue: Navbar overlap: the logo Link uses `absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` while the nav links live in the same flex row with gap-8; the logo is therefore outside the flex sizing calculation, so longer Spanish labels grow rightwards past the viewport centre and paint under/over the logo below ~1400px.
